description_en: Queries the data parsing settings in a specified category
description_zh: 查询指定类目的数据解析设置
name: GetParseSettings

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the file belongs. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 文件所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The category ID, which is the `CategoryId` returned by AddCategory. To view the category ID, click the ID icon next to the category name on the Unstructured Data tab of the Application Data (https://bailian.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center) page
parameters.help_zh: 类目 ID，即 AddCategory 接口返回的`CategoryId`，或者在<props="china">应用数据 (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)-文件页签</props><props="intl">应用数据 (https://bailian.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)-非结构化数据页签</props>，单击类目名称旁的 ID 图标获取

Data.description_zh: 请求成功返回的业务数据

FileType.description_en: The file type. Valid values are: pdf, docx, doc, etc. All supported file types in the category are listed here
FileType.description_zh: 文件类型，扩展名，可能值为： pdf、docx、doc等，列举当前类目中支持的所有文件类型

Parser.description_en:
The parser used for files of the current type. Valid values:

DOCMIND (Intelligent parsing)
DOCMIND_DIGITAL (Digital parsing)
DOCMIND_LLM_VERSION (LLM parsing)
DASH_QWEN_VL_PARSER (Qwen VL parsing)
Parser.description_zh:
解析该类目下当前类型文件使用的解析器。可能值为：
DOCMIND：智能文档解析
DOCMIND_DIGITAL：电子文档解析
DOCMIND_LLM_VERSION：大模型文档解析
DASH_QWEN_VL_PARSER：Qwen VL解析

ParserConfig.description_en: The parser configuration. Currently, this is available only for Qwen VL parsing
ParserConfig.description_zh: 解析器配置，仅在类型被设置为Qwen VL解析时才会返回
